steps.name: Noble Scholar
steps.text: Oh, what an honor it is for me to meet you here, Hatshepsut Hanimefendi.

steps.name: Noble Scholar
steps.text: The slipper from the early New Calendar era you brought has certainly broadened my knowledge of history. I had no idea the people of so many centuries ago had such fine techniques in crafting footwear.

steps.name: Noble Scholar
steps.text: To think they could make a shoe that fits the curve of the foot so well. As for the lotus ornament atop it, vivid beyond words.

steps.name: Noble Scholar
steps.text: Not to mention this slipper was made not long after the great explosion, and it reflects the drastic shifts in the local climate.

steps.name: Noble Scholar
steps.text: It's a pity that it's missing its twin. I fear it won't win on its own.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: That's fine, second place is enough for me. It's the participation that counts.

steps.name: Noble Scholar
steps.text: Of course, of course. As daughter of the Padishah, Hatshepsut Hanimefendi, you will one day take up the mantle of Padishah. I am sure such a trifling honor would not be worth fretting over.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: That's... still a bit early. There's a lot of things we can't say for sure.

steps.name: High-status Magnate
steps.text: I've heard your younger brother has been selected to become court historian, and that he will set out for the City of Gold in two months, Hatshepsut Hanim.

steps.name: Noble Scholar
steps.text: Ah, even a girl as talented as Hatshepsut Hanim was not chosen for the post, which just goes to show how gifted her brother is.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: *sigh* We're practically the same, really.

steps.name: High-status Magnate
steps.text: Are you trying to say, good sir, that becoming a padishah does not require talent and ability? I believe that if Hatshepsut Hanim were to take that position, her family would no doubt continue to bask in glory.

steps.name: Noble Scholar
steps.text: This is different. Hatshepsut Hanim's family is Sargon's most illustrious line of historians, after all.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Almost time for us to register. Have you thought of what to submit?

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Not yet.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: You so brazenly got into line, but you don't have a single treasure on you?

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Is there anything about my walking posture that needs improvement?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Never mind, forget it.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: I guess you'll have to rely on me again.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: I'm not about to let my subordinate lose. Give me some time to think of a plan.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: I once won the silver medal in a sprint.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Are you thinking of snatching the golden cup and running? No good.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: These rich folk brought along some tough bodyguards. See the way their feet move as they look around? They've spent time in the ameeri armies.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: I also earned a silver medal in pankration.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Robbery? Everyone worth targeting is already here. How would we participate with stolen goods without getting caught?

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: There is also the silver medal I got from a ceremonial dance competition.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: That's your plan of attack?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: *sigh* No need to make things hard for yourself...

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: In truth, I have ten silver medals across ten different events. I keep them on my person at all times.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: ...Ten silver medals?

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: These medals are embodiments of traditional Minoan culture, and my most prized honors.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Honor should not be regarded as a rarity with which to judge superiority, but in particular circumstances, I have no other choice.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Besides, I hope you do not misunderstand me, Narantuya. I would never resort to anything dishonorable. It would disgrace my family.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: I guess I really did misunderstand you.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: *sigh* My competent subordinate, my great endeavor...

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Sorry, did you say something just now?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Nothing important. I was just saying that considering you've never won a gold medal, it's no wonder you want that gold cup, haha.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Don't worry. I have a plan.

steps.name: Nervous Ceremony Judge
steps.text: *cough*...

steps.name: Nervous Ceremony Judge
steps.text: May I ask... why the herald led me here? What orders am I to receive?

steps.name: Woman Behind the Jeweled Screen
steps.text: Eh? No, no, no orders here. Just a request.

steps.name: Woman Behind the Jeweled Screen
steps.text: If you happen to see a single golden slipper... Do not give it too high a mark.

steps.name: Woman Behind the Jeweled Screen
steps.text: Ah, but also not too low! We must still uphold the professionalism of our historians! Let's say... second place. Second place would be good.

steps.name: Woman Behind the Jeweled Screen
steps.text: Please! This is really, really important!

steps.name: Nervous Ceremony Judge
steps.text: That exhibit has precious historical value, but if you wish to reduce its mark for subjective reasons, that would not be considered unfair to our other competitors.

steps.name: Woman Behind the Jeweled Screen
steps.text: If you have deduced my identity, then please keep that a secret as well. Thank you.

steps.name: Nervous Ceremony Judge
steps.text: I will, resplendent Hanim.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: ...Sorry.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: I'm definitely going to apologize to all my teachers and fellow archaeologists after this.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: I... I definitely, absolutely, 100% cannot lose, just this once! Why does everyone think I already lost to that little brat?

spans.text: I... I definitely, absolutely, 100% cannot lose, just this once! Why does
think I already lost to that little brat?

steps.name: Nervous Ceremony Judge
steps.text: AIIEEEEEEEE———!

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: (*covers mouth*) ...Did I scare him?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Did you get all that?

steps.name: Terrified Ceremony Judge
steps.text: Y-Yes! Th-The set of silver medals from M-Minos... must get a high mark... It will get th-third place...

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Don't worry, I already had a talk with most of your fellow judges. We got along rather well. I hope you will too.

steps.name: Terrified Ceremony Judge
steps.text: Ah... Padishah Effendi... The corrupt must be hanged? F-Forgive me!

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: (Can't believe he's this scared already! I didn't get this big a reaction from security and the other judges earlier. What illusion did he see?)

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: (*sigh* I'll be dragging you back to the gate, then. Maybe I overdid it with the Arts?)

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: (Wait. I hear footsteps.)

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Oh, I don't see the judge here either. Must have been escorted back to the meeting hall by security.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: I better go get my own things done. The sun waits for no man, after all.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Oho, and who is this I happen to run into? What luck.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Sorry, could you say that one more time?

steps.name: Gathering Staff
steps.text: I am honored to inform you, hanimefendi, that your entry has proceeded to the final round of judging. In other words, you are now in the top three.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: No, not that. The other part.

steps.name: Gathering Staff
steps.text: I ask that you follow me to the riverside in a little while, where the prizes will be given and the treasures will be immersed into the river.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: So... You're going to throw my ten silver medals into the river?

steps.name: Gathering Staff
steps.text: Perish the thought, hanimefendi. That would be rather crude, and we would never dare to offend the river god.

steps.name: Gathering Staff
steps.text: We will place the treasures atop a small boat made of papyrus reeds, alongside gold, silver, and jewels to help weigh it down. We will sing hymns and chants as we watch the boat slowly sink into the waters.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: This wasn't mentioned on the brochure.

steps.name: Gathering Staff
steps.text: I am terribly sorry. It was written in the instructions all participants had to sign. The competition's original purpose was to find treasures with the most historical value to knock upon the gate of the god.

steps.name: Gathering Staff
steps.text: During the Flood Festival, those favored winners will witness the river god with their own eyes as He wanders the riverside.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Forgive me, this was my mistake. It was close to the cutoff when I signed up, and I did not have time to read all ten pages of instructions.

steps.name: Gathering Staff
steps.text: Ah, that is a shame. As it is extremely rare for tourists to reach the final round of selection, you will be given a second opportunity to reaffirm your commitment.

steps.name: Gathering Staff
steps.text: Do you wish to continue participating?

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Narantuya...

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: She hasn't returned yet.

steps.name: Gathering Staff
steps.text: Do you wish to seek a specialist consultant? I can bring you to the chief judge to discuss—

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: No need. What I seek is not a suggestion.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: I will continue my participation.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Hello? Anat, listen to me! You can start preparing the victory feast now!

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Hm-hm, of course, I would never take for granted the generosity you’ve shown by lending me the general!

spans.text: take for granted the generosity you’ve shown by lending me the general!

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: I promise you that I'll stick the gem in when we get back tonight. If Zubayr goes through any changes, you'll be able to see them for yourself.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: ...Relax, I've been taking good care of him. No stains or damage, I promise.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: ...Y-You want to speak to him? No, nonono, he... he's under my protection, right? How can I just give him a communicator when everyone's staring at me?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Why don't we talk about something else?! You don't know how hard I've had it! I've been talking up these old pedantic judges all morning just to guarantee second place.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Listen, they're about to declare the winner at the big meeting spot. Once I get the gem, I'll head right back to the museum, where it's nice and quiet—

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Sorry.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Ah, it's fine...

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: ...Weird, not like the sidewalk's narrow here.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: *phew* I can finally rest easy. Pepe's handled the gem issue, and Zubayr is just fine too.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: Should we have a drink together later?

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: Is there something you wanted to say?

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: You're not going to want to hear it.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: I do want to hear your suggestion, Titi.

spans.text: want to hear your suggestion, Titi.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: You might think this is ridiculous, but... I feel like we might have to start the exhibition over, and keep the accident under wraps.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Just treat it as some sort of performance gone awry, then display it in a more vivid and... true-to-life manner?

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: So display a walking mummy and some artifacts, push up ticket prices a little while we're at it?

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: More or less, I guess...

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: You do know what our people use to scare crybaby children, right?

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: The exhibits being a bit odd isn't a bad thing!

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: My old Columbian museum had an exhibit: 'Has Science Gone Too Far? Creative Ideas That Would Be Scarier Successes Than Failures'.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: But Titi, that's the idea behind a business whose number one goal is to make money. If we tried that here, a lot of people would be mad. A lot of people.

spans.text: But Titi, that's the idea behind a business whose number one goal is to make money. If we tried that here, a lot of people would be mad. A

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: History itself is the foundation of this city!

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Isn't the foundation that vein of gemstones that's nearly dried up?

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: You really shouldn't say things like that when we go to meet the nobles later.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: That family is as ancient as the bricks in the tomb in the museum's great hall. They can be rather conservative.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Meddling here and there... What's wrong with those high-ups anyway?! Can't they just fork over a sum of money every year and forget about the museum like Pepe's family?

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: I worked hard to become acting curator, Titi. I really don't want to cause any sort of inconvenience.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Inconvenience?! You're seriously calling this an 'inconvenience'?!

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: That's not what I meant...

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Have it your way, then. I'm leaving.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: Titi, I...

steps.name: Meticulous Ceremony Judge
steps.text: (Are you okay? You're sweating buckets...)

steps.name: Nervous Ceremony Judge
steps.text: (A-Am I? It's rather hot outside, haha. You're sweating too...)

steps.name: Ceremony Host
steps.text: Next up is a descendant of a glorious clan of historians, the one who shares ballads of kings and heroes, explorer of all Sargon, purveyor of knowledge, a respected Padishah's daughter—

steps.name: Ceremony Host
steps.text: Hatshepsut Hanim and her rare treasure!

steps.name: Nervous Ceremony Judge
steps.text: (Are you, err... Are you going to announce the result?)

steps.name: Meticulous Ceremony Judge
steps.text: (Oh, no, this is a rather important occasion. I leave it to you.)

steps.name: Nervous Ceremony Judge
steps.text: (...Haha, well, I guess I can't get out of this one.)

steps.name: Nervous Ceremony Judge
steps.text: Ahem...

steps.name: Nervous Ceremony Judge
steps.text: Uh, this golden slipper is adorned with a lotus flower woven of gold thread, specially designed to accommodate the sudden changes in the Sargonian climate at the time, with distinct characteristics from the era.

steps.name: Nervous Ceremony Judge
steps.text: Not only that, but it comes from an illustrious family of imperial historians.

steps.name: Nervous Ceremony Judge
steps.text: It would be difficult to find a slipper so well-preserved in the marketplace, and it's a submission rather uncharacteristic of a family of historians, at that—

steps.name: Nervous Ceremony Judge
steps.text: For past ceremonies, such families would usually submit letters, manuscripts, and other pieces of writing.

steps.name: Nervous Ceremony Judge
steps.text: But today, this sole slipper reveals to us another side of the life of a noble past. Its value is incalculable!

steps.name: Ceremony Host
steps.text: Okay, thank you for the commentary. Next, I will announce the judges' decision.

steps.name: Ceremony Host
steps.text: Disregarding the highest and the lowest marks, Hatshepsut Hanim's final tally is...

steps.name: Ceremony Host
steps.text: —94.95 points.

steps.name: Ceremony Host
steps.text: Ah, what a shame, resplendent Hatshepsut Hanim, off by a mere 0.05 points. You are in second place, for now...

steps.name: Nervous Ceremony Judge
steps.text: This result was born in the interests of fairness and our respect for history. I do hope you understand, Hatshepsut Hanim.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Oh, don't worry about it. I expected as much, heheh.

steps.name: Nervous Ceremony Judge
steps.text: Menat-Ha'mait is honored to undertake your challenge... L-Let's move on to the next item, shall we?

steps.name: Ceremony Host
steps.text: Very well. Next, we have the last, but certainly not the least, entry into our competition...

steps.name: Ceremony Host
steps.text: A foreign treasure, a set of silver medals from Minos. We invite our expert to give an assessment.

steps.name: Meticulous Ceremony Judge
steps.text: We are all aware that places far from Sargon also possess their own brilliant civilizations. The art and culture of Minos has proven to be harmonious with Sargonian social mores.

steps.name: Meticulous Ceremony Judge
steps.text: This set of medals embodies not only the Minoan love of sports, but more importantly, unlike most of the other entries, its year of manufacture can be determined with precision.

steps.name: Meticulous Ceremony Judge
steps.text: Indeed, our lives are well-adorned with gold, but products fashioned from silver are a rarity.

steps.name: Meticulous Ceremony Judge
steps.text: In fact, some historical periods saw silver considered the more precious metal.

steps.name: Ceremony Host
steps.text: What a fascinating analysis! Well then, which three contestants will win the opportunity to represent the city in offering these treasures to the river? Do allow me to announce this particular treasure's score...

steps.name: Ceremony Host
steps.text: Disregarding the highest and the lowest marks, hailing from Minos, Aspasia Hanim's final tally is...

steps.name: Ceremony Host
steps.text: —94.60 points.

steps.name: Ceremony Host
steps.text: This level of fierce competition is unprecedented! Your final position is third place, Aspasia Hanim. Though I regret you did not place higher, you have still secured the chance to perform the offering.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: I thank you. This was precisely the approval I sought.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: However, if you so permit, I would protest your arrangement of these prizes after we conclude. I believe a golden Minoan goblet should rank higher than a third place prize.

steps.name: Ceremony Host
steps.text: Very well, Hanim, but please come up to the stage first with your treasure. Go with our attendant there.

steps.name: Ceremony Host
steps.text: In third place, Aspasia Hanim.

steps.name: Ceremony Host
steps.text: In second place, Hatshepsut Hanim.

steps.name: Ceremony Host
steps.text: In first place, Rashad Hanim.

steps.name: Ceremony Host
steps.text: I ask that our three winning contestants take care not to damage the treasures they are holding—

steps.name: Rashad
steps.text: Oh no!

steps.name: Rashad
steps.text: Terribly sorry about that. It's far too hot, and I collapsed for a moment... I couldn't hold it steady. This is quite embarrassing.

steps.name: Rashad
steps.text: *sigh* It's a pity this ancient clay pot I brought shattered to pieces. I assume that offering pottery chips would be an affront to the river god?

steps.name: Ceremony Host
steps.text: I... don't believe this has ever happened before...

steps.name: Rashad
steps.text: This is heartbreaking. I fear I will have to give up first place.

steps.name: Rashad
steps.text: Resplendent Hatshepsut Hanim, daughter of the Padishah, you hold the highest title among all attendees. To bestow first place upon you is only fitting.

steps.name: Rashad
steps.text: And so I voluntarily renounce my position and withdraw from the competition.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: Ceremony Host
steps.text: Err... What an unexpected turn of events! But I do believe everyone is in agreement that our resplendent daughter of the Padishah should be awarded first place!

steps.name: Ceremony Host
steps.text: And so, our second, third and fourth place contestants will become our new first, second, and third place respectively.

steps.name: Ceremony Host
steps.text: Let's all give them our heartiest congratulations!
